title: Will CTV Advertising Continue Its Reign in 2022?

facts.fact: The article was published on December 19, 2021, under the byline of Anton Liaskovskyi.
Author Anton Liaskovskyi is CEO of AdPlayer.Pro, which the page describes as a global provider of advanced outstream video-advertising solutions, so the author has a vendor affiliation.
facts.quote: Anton Liaskovskyi is the CEO of AdPlayer.Pro, a global provider of advanced outstream video-advertising solutions.

facts.fact: Per the author, the CTV sector has been rapidly shifting its development focus to programmatic advertising over the past 12 months (as of the December 2021 article).
facts.quote: the CTV sector has been rapidly shifting the focus of its development to programmatic advertising over the past 12 months.

facts.fact: The author forecasts that the share of each CTV OS operator is not likely to grow big enough to form data monopolies.
facts.quote: the share of each OS operator on the market isn’t likely to grow big enough to form data monopolies.

facts.fact: The author predicts that new CTV adtech software aimed at better verification of video ad viewability will be introduced.
facts.quote: the introduction of new CTV adtech software, specifically aimed at the better verification of video ad viewability

facts.fact: The author states that CTV OS operators' audience data can easily become a valuable second-party data asset in 2022.
facts.quote: can easily become a valuable second-party data asset in 2022.

facts.fact: Entrepreneur's policy states that opinions expressed by its contributors are the contributors' own.
facts.quote: Opinions expressed by Entrepreneur contributors are their own.
